latest_release.name: Yosys 0.71
latest_release.body:
Yosys 0.70 .. Yosys 0.71
--------------------------
 * Commands and options
    - Added "-readable" and "-small" to "dump" and "write_rtlil" passes
      for convenience with the new string implementation.
    - Added "shuffle" pass to deterministically reorder design objects.
    - Added "-target" and "-family" to "verific" and "read_slang" passes
      as experimental feature to specify FPGA synthesis target.
    - Added "-nodec_attr" and "-dec_param" to "write_verilog" pass for
      compatibility with other tools.

 * Various
    - Strings have been reimplemented with prefix deduplication to improve
      performance. Plugins may need to be adapted. Please refer to
      docs/source/yosys_internals/idstring.rst
    - MCM pass now uses HCUB algorithm, improving runtime performance on
      big multipliers and removing the 32-bit maximum size.
    - Fixed out-of-memory crashes on large casez/priority case statements.
    - verific: Improved detection of unsupported SVA constructs.
